title: Fan Pulse Gameday Walkthrough
subtitle: Find the live sports emotion while it matters

scenes.caption: Open Fan Pulse Gameday and show the live angle surface.
scenes.narration: Fan Pulse Gameday is for live sports moments. It helps identify what fans are reacting to right now, then turns that emotion into a timely content angle.

scenes.caption: Show how the page turns live reaction into a post angle.
scenes.narration: The value is timing. Instead of posting yesterday's angle, you can see the live fan emotion and create while the moment still matters.
